meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing specialist with intelligent DuckDB/Polars selection for maximum performance. Always includes numpy, never uses pandas, runs everything through uv. Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'analyze this file', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'last 30 days data', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 CSV、Parquet 等数据文件,完成汇总、筛选与关联统计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果面对数据文件想快速搞清规律和统计结果
copy.tagline_en: Analyze CSV, Parquet, and JSON files to summarize, filter, and join data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with data files and want quick insights without complex coding

howto.what: Claude会变成数据处理专家：用uv运行Python分析CSV、Parquet、JSON等文件，自动选DuckDB或Polars，始终包含numpy、不用pandas，完成过滤、排序、分组、统计等，并生成图表。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析数据、查看CSV/Parquet/JSON文件内容，或进行其他数据操作时触发；不处理纯文本、配置或简单计算。

say.text: 分析这个CSV文件，按类别汇总销售额。
say.note: Claude会用DuckDB查询文件并返回汇总表。

say.text: 对比昨天和今天的数据，找出差异。
say.note: Claude会比较两天数据并输出差异。

say.text: 这个parquet文件里有什么？给我描述一下。
say.note: Claude会展示文件结构、字段和统计信息。

howto.what_en: Claude runs Python via uv to analyze data files (CSV, Parquet, JSON). It auto-selects DuckDB or Polars, always includes numpy, never pandas, and handles filtering, sorting, grouping, stats, and charts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to analyze data, inspect CSV/Parquet/JSON file contents, or perform other data operations. Not for plain text, configs, or simple calculations.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV file and summarize sales by category.
say_en.note: Claude will query the file with DuckDB and return a summary.

say_en.text: Compare yesterday's and today's data and find the differences.
say_en.note: Claude will compare both days and output differences.

say_en.text: What's in this parquet file? Describe it to me.
say_en.note: Claude will show the file schema, fields, and statistics.
